refusal_chain.summary: 0x1BE7F4 does not intrinsically need a writer-set proof. It fell through to the S2b nested writer-set rule only because S5 refused first, and S5 refused because the context type-closure was under-approximated to one table. The neighbours did not fall through because their singleton target sets happened to be satisfied by the one surviving table.

s5_refusal_condition.why: with only AES_GCM_HW in the closure, the AES_GCM_HW.cipherupdate slot resolves to the folded 0x1bede0; the ARIA table (which supplies 0x1bee80) is absent from the closure, so the computed set is a strict subset of the two enumerated targets

root_cause.defect: the pre-fix cfg(test) span over-approximated a semicolon-terminated assertion item into the next item
swallowed_production_items: src/provider/cipher_gcm.rs:2059 unsafe fn aria_gcm_newctx (old span 2052-2079) and its ossl_gcm_initctx call at :2071
src/provider/cipher_gcm.rs:2216 unsafe fn sm4_gcm_newctx (old span 2209-2236) and its ossl_gcm_initctx call at :2228
root_cause.mechanism: _phw_constructions skips a helper call whose position is inside a cfg(test) span (_phw_relative_ok); dropping the ARIA and SM4 constructors left the ProvGcmCtx hw@0xf0 type-closure as {AES_GCM_HW} (one table).
root_cause.why_neighbours_passed: 0x1BE7DE (aadupdate) and 0x1BE80C (cipherfinal) enumerate one target each; AES_GCM_HW supplies both, so target_set == wanted even with one table. 0x1BE7F4 enumerates two.

downstream_s2b.why_it_is_not_a_real_obligation: S2b indexes stores by bare displacement 0x18 and admits unqualified bases. The named std::sync::once closure is once_lock::OnceLock<Table>::initialize for `named_groups` (a different type in the ffc path), not a ProvGcmCtx.hw writer. The 6 overlapping 16-byte stores are likewise other owning types. S2b never ran once S5 resolved.

option_a_complete_writer_set.why: The source writer set of ProvGcmHw.cipherupdate is already the complete enumerated {AES_GCM_HW, ARIA_GCM_HW, SM4_GCM_HW}. The missing element was a constructor, not a writer. The std::sync::once store is an S2b displacement over-approximation; silencing it would not restore the missing constructors and would not change S5's target set. No contract class was widened.

option_b_prove_the_fold.why: The two ENUMERATED targets do not fold: ossl_gcm_cipher_update is 0x1bee80 and sm4_gcm_cipher_update is 0x1bede0 in this exact image (distinct function starts). Only the non-enumerated source function generic_aes_gcm_cipher_update is absent and folds into sm4_gcm_cipher_update (0x1bede0). A singleton target set would therefore be false.

decision.chosen: Repair the cfg(test) item-extent span (tool-only). It is the root cause, it restores the ARIA and SM4 constructors, and the resulting three-table type-closure makes the computed target set exactly the enumerated two-address set. No predicate, contract or source file was changed.
